name: Dotrow
description: A single row of dots, sitting on a rule that runs the width of the cell.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 40%, transparent 40%) 0 0 / 16.67% 16.67%, linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 33.34%, #000 33.34% 50%, transparent 50%); mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 40%, transparent 40%) 0 0 / 16.67% 16.67%, linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 33.34%, #000 33.34% 50%, transparent 50%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 52%; height: 6%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
